primary_protocol: Six serial balanced orders; one observation per subject in each order; no excluded full-input warmup or outlier. Independent six-order repetition is not pooled.
decision: Correct outputs, exact physical update counts, all prior codegen qualifications and unchanged work semantics are required. A performance promotion requires >=1% lower median and >=4/6 faster pairs against the accepted twelve-round parent in each of two independent full-input cohorts. Inconclusive small differences require a separately predeclared expanded cohort or rejection.
diagnostics: Separate exact-code profiles, hardware counters and thread appearance bounds; never primary timing samples.
scope: Disjoint owner-constructed metadata lanes only. Call effects, source guards, failure origins, capabilities, metering, worker count, QoS, affinity and power settings are unchanged.
